Dated :- August 2, 2019 P.C. :-
1.

A policy of the Municipal Corporation to grant temporary no-objection certificate for slaughter of animals (sheeps/ goats only) on occasion of any festival or ceremony or under special circumstances and framed under the orders of this court is handed over to us by Mr.Sakhare learned senior counsel appearing for the Municipal Corporation.
This copy handed in is taken on record and marked as 'X' for identification.

2. Mr.Sakhare, on taking instructions from the officials of the Municipal Corporation and present in court, says that every single party, who is before this court, either the petitioner or the intervener, is free to give any suggestions to the Municipal Corporation officials in-charge of implementation of this policy and that the Municipal Corporation is not so rigid or inflexible as not to accept the reasonable view or suggestion and thereupon modify or change any of the terms and conditions in this policy.
J.V.SALUNKE,PS 906-WP.3195.2018.doc 3.

It is stated that on their own, the municipal officials have devised a scheme which they think is foolproof and if anything is lacking therein, before the next date, the suggestions and views should be placed for due consideration and regard of these officials and together with the representatives of the NGOs before this court, appropriate steps and measures would be taken.

sentences.text: During the course of today's hearing, we suggested to both sides that there are several entry points and check points/ nakas.
If suitable measures are taken, the vehicles entering the city, along with the animals and traded for slaughter, can be identified.

That there is due check and thereafter,
a list is maintained of such animals and vehicles.
Thereupon, it can be forwarded to the police and the municipal machinery for necessary action in accordance with law.
It is everybody's experience that escape routes are chosen so as to avoid these check points such as octroi nakas or toll plazas.

Thereafter, it was suggested that when there is a Freeway, by use of which, one can enter the city or even come down and enter the suburbs such as Chembur, Kurla, Byculla, Sewri etc., then, on either sides, namely, the Freeway, Eastern and Western Express Highways, vigil has to be maintained.
If such joint vigil can be maintained, then, that would be ideal.

In addition to this, an awareness drive has to be launched and social J.V.SALUNKE,PS 906-WP.3195.2018.doc media can be used so as to spread the right message, particularly highlighting public health and public safety so also provisions of law, namely, the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Ultimately, if the slaughtering results in consumption of animal meat as food, then, naturally, the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006 with all its provisions has to be adhered to.

5. We hope and trust that slaughtering animals in closed areas, particularly in flats and homes can be prevented by not only penal measures, but with the awareness drives and social messaging.
6.
At the request of both sides, we place these matters at 3.00 p.m. on 5th August, 2019.
7. The parties to act upon an authenticated copy of this order.
(SANDEEP K. SHINDE, J.)
